breakdown.description: The two concentrated loads are replaced by a distributed couple over a boundary segment
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly specified replacing the two concentrated loads with a 'self-equilibrated distributed couple acting over the short right-edge segment between y = 0.2 and y = 0.3.' The generated specification correctly applies the two horizontal point loads as individual PointSource terms at their respective boundary locations: '-3000 N in the x-direction at (1, 0.2)' and '+3000 N in the x-direction at (1, 0.3)', which matches the ground truth's instruction to 'Apply the two horizontal point loads as equal and opposite PointSource terms at the two stated boundary locations.'
